text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How did I do? Wasn't it the best I've
shown yet?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't think I've ever run with my
pedal to
the metal like that before!
choice_data_list: 本当に楽しそうだったな
本当に楽しそうだったね
choice_data_list_en: You really looked like you were having fun.
You really looked like you were having fun, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the fans and the younger
students could
feel the excitement!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time to move on to the classic
year.
There are even more fun races
ahead of us!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And that means we're aiming for the
Classic races,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the way she ran today, there's no
doubt in
my mind that she'll hold her
own in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So it makes sense that we next aim for
the race
many consider to be their
prelude...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so there's an order that you have to
follow?
I'm down with that! Let's do it!
choice_data_list: 『スプリングステークス』に挑もう！

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, I'm looking forward to seeing
what it'll
be like! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
On that note, it looks like I have an
interview
now. I'll see you later!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You did a great job! Here, have some
water and
relax a bit...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
She's... waaaay faster than the rumors
suggested.
She's like... a monster...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after finishing the big run...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky! That last race of yours was

downright amaz'n!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just watching it got me all worked up! I
had to do
a few laps on the track by
m'self afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe, calm down! Take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Inhale... Exhale... Inha—hack, cough!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That really was a great race, Maruzen.
You
showed us what we should all be
striving for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I'm honored to hear you say so.
From
here on out, I'm going to keep
showing you my
best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to watching and learning
even
more from you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there she is! Maruzensky, we'd love
to have a
word with you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Please tell us about your stunning run in
the Asahi
Hai!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, look at all the reporters...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She really is someone we can look up to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: そっちも取材、お疲れ様
choice_data_list_en: Good work on your interview, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and with all this press coverage, I
didn't
have time to train today...
choice_data_list: そっちも取材、お疲れ様
choice_data_list_en: Good work on your interview, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I don't like it, but... I really
wanted to
cut loose and run some more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She just wants to run all the time. She
really does
love it from the bottom of
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, that racer over there ran with
me in the
Asahi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I need to talk to you about the
next race.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She heard about me and came to
challenge me in
the Asahi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She told me how hard she trained and
how she
wouldn't lose.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A rival...
choice_data_list_en: She's an important rival, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a rival! That's why the race was so
fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But, for some reason, she seems down in
the
dumps...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to drop some
encouragement on
her, like a true rival
should! ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please let me drop out of the
next Spring
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Drop out? Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I heard that Maruzensky is scheduled to
run. I
know it's pathetic to say this, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to run when... you know you
can't win.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm honestly surprised you would feel
that way...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...But I understand. Let's find a race that
better
suits you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: She's dropping out... because of me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That same power of Maruzensky's that
makes fans
love her seems to leave a
wholly different
impression on other
runners.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, every race is important for
us!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural to be careful when
choosing the
races you run! Let's keep
that in mind moving
forward, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm taking off! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm taking off! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she runs off, Maruzensky's stride
somehow
doesn't seem as buoyant as it
usually is...
